title: nested location tracking or multi-level warehouse container logic

posts.name: Mikkel Holch
posts.cooked:
Hi all

New to ERPNext, but are trying to give it a go…

but one thing we need, is abaility to put items in boxes.
now these boxes will be placed on pallets for storage, these pallets with many boxes can and will be moved, and the pallets have ID’s and then alle shelfs have ID’s based on location. but not sure ERPNext can handle this out of the box.

is there a nice way to handle this or should we look into creating this.

our current setup uses a custom program.

We have:
Locations (Warehouse, area, shelfs) items that can’t move
Containers(Pallets, boxes ) items that can contain items

A item can be placed in a Item(product#) → Box(ID) → Pallet(ID) → Shelf(ID)
An item can be placed on a location Item(product#) → Shelf(ID)

now when we lookup a Item we know how many and where to find (can be multiple places)

We are looking into ERPNext because of the BOM’s

and we might put some effort into the storage logistic (also label printing for locations / box ID labels)

/M

posts.name: Pawan
posts.cooked: You will need to use Putaway (Putaway Rule) along with some additional inventory dimensions (Inventory Dimension) dimensions to achieve this. If you need any barcode/qr code integrations, those may need to be custom built as per your requirements to help with Item Traceability in your warehouse.
